input._script:
using JSON3, Base64, CUDA
const FILES = Dict("w0" => "", "w1" => "")
mods = Dict{String,Module}()
for (k, b) in FILES
    m = Module(Symbol("H", k)); Base.include_string(m, String(base64decode(b))); mods[k] = m
end
J = mods["w0"].JACC
res = Dict{String,Any}("device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())), "jacc_synchronize_defined" => isdefined(J, :synchronize), "rows" => Any[])
for (n, m) in ((65536, 2000), (65536, 20000), (1024, 2000), (262144, 20000))
    row = Dict{String,Any}("n" => n, "m" => m)
    for tag in ("w0", "w1")
        M = mods[tag]
        x = M.JACC.array(rand(n)); y = M.JACC.zeros(Float64, n)
        f = M.heavy_jacc
        f(x, y, n, m); CUDA.synchronize()
        tr = Float64[]; ta = Float64[]; ok = true
        yref = Array(y)
        for rep in 1:7
            CUDA.synchronize(); t0 = time_ns()
            f(x, y, n, m)
            t1 = time_ns(); CUDA.synchronize(); t2 = time_ns()
            push!(tr, (t1 - t0) / 1e6); push!(ta, (t2 - t0) / 1e6)
        end
        row["ret_ms_" * tag] = minimum(tr); row["all_ms_" * tag] = minimum(ta); row["ret_frac_" * tag] = sum(tr) / sum(ta)
        row["same_" * tag] = Array(y) == yref
        row["sum_" * tag] = sum(Array(y))
    end
    push!(res["rows"], row)
end
println(JSON3.write(res))
